ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits_summary: Maternity cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for the first living child, and ₹6,000 for the second child if it is a girl.
exclusions: Women in regular employment with Central/State Government or PSUs
application_steps: Register your pregnancy at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility.
Submit the PMMVY Form 1-A online or through an ASHA/Anganwadi worker.
Complete child immunization to receive the final installment.
